players.product: QCT single-molecule NGS (smNGS) prenatal (UNITY) and oncology (Northstar) cell-free DNA tests with proprietary algorithms

quarterly_data.signal: CEO: on June 24 BillionToOne published a peer-reviewed study in the Journal of Liquid Biopsy validating Northstar Response for monitoring immunotherapy and immuno-combination therapy. The study included 142 patients and more than 570 samples across two prospective cohorts and 12 tumor types. Molecular progression strongly predicted worse survival, a stronger predictor than imaging alone and stronger still when the two are combined, and the test separated radiographically stable patients into true responders and nonresponders. The publication is designed to support the pursuit of MolDX Medicare coverage for Northstar Response in the IO and IO-combination therapy settings.
quarterly_data.figure: 142 patients; more than 570 samples; two prospective cohorts; 12 tumor types
